# costfluent_workspace_provider (Resource)

Enables a Costfluent provider connection in a workspace, for the whole connection or for chosen accounts of it. One connection can be enabled in several workspaces, each for its own accounts. Needs a token with `viewWorkspace`, `addWorkspaceProvider` and `removeWorkspaceProvider` on the workspace, and an organization token with `addWorkspaceProvider` and `manageProviders` for what the organization decides. Creating the link and any change but turning it off need `addWorkspaceProvider`; turning it off, creating it turned off included, and destroying it need `removeWorkspaceProvider`. Which accounts a workspace reads is the organization's to decide, so creating the link and changing `account_ids` also need `manageProviders` on an organization token; a workspace token can only turn the link on or off and destroy it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "costfluent_workspace" "payments" {
  name     = "Payments"
  currency = "USD"
}

resource "costfluent_provider" "aws_payer" {
  key  = "aws"
  name = "AWS Organization"
  credentials = {
    role_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/CostfluentBillingRole"
  }
  settings = {
    export_bucket        = "acme-costfluent-export"
    export_bucket_region = "us-east-1"
  }
}

# The payments workspace reads only the payments team's member accounts of the organization.
# Other workspaces can enable the same connection for their own accounts.
resource "costfluent_workspace_provider" "payments_aws" {
  workspace_id = costfluent_workspace.payments.id
  provider_id  = costfluent_provider.aws_payer.id
  account_ids  = ["210987654321", "345678901234"]
}

# Without account_ids the workspace reads the whole connection, including accounts discovered later.
resource "costfluent_workspace_provider" "finance_aws" {
  workspace_id = "wsp_0000000000000000000002"
  provider_id  = costfluent_provider.aws_payer.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) Provider connection the workspace reads. Changing it recreates the resource.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace that reads the connection. Changing it recreates the resource.

### Optional

- `account_ids` (Set of String) The cloud provider's own ids of the accounts the workspace reads: AWS account numbers or Azure subscription ids. Omitted or empty, the workspace reads the whole connection, including accounts discovered later. Only AWS and Azure connections list accounts, and an account the connection does not cover is refused.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the workspace reads the connection's cost. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `added_at` (String) When the connection was enabled in the workspace.
- `id` (String) Workspace provider ID.
- `provider_key` (String) What the connection connects to, such as `aws` or `azure`.
- `provider_name` (String) Name of the provider connection.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A workspace provider is imported by "<workspace ID>:<workspace provider ID>"; the workspace is required.
terraform import costfluent_workspace_provider.payments_aws wsp_0000000000000000000001:wpr_0000000000000000000001
```
